name: app-dev
description: Expert-level development skill for building, debugging, reviewing, and migrating Freshworks Platform 3.0 marketplace applications. Provides /fdk-fix, /fdk-migrate, /fdk-refactor, /fdk-review commands.

commands.name: fdk-fix
commands.description: Fix all platform validation errors and lint errors

commands.name: fdk-migrate
commands.description: Migrate Platform 2.3 (2.x), FDK 9.x, Node 18 → Platform 3.0, FDK 10, Node 24

commands.name: fdk-refactor
commands.description: Reduce function complexity to meet cyclomatic complexity ≤ 7

commands.name: fdk-review
commands.description: Review app using multiple rounds of fdk validate
